summary: V3.8 review — POST /api/characters/{cid}/journal endpoint + ActorPopover frontend component. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_iter10_v38.py with 10 focused tests, ALL 10 PASS. Owner-happy-path (entry shape id/text/by_uid/by_name/created_at, folio.journal becomes/stays an array, [journal]-tagged chat row inserted with kind='journal' + character_id), access control (player@ gets 403 on Cyma since not seated in TEST Campaign E2E; GM-of-campaign gets 200), validation (empty=422, >2000 chars=422, bad cid=404, cross-campaign session_id saves entry but suppresses chat echo — verified by snapshotting chat log size before/after on a TEST_V38_OtherCamp/Sess), defensive coercion (motor stamps folio.journal='legacy text from before V3.8' as a string, endpoint call returns count=1 + GET /api/characters/{cid} confirms folio.journal is now [new_entry] only). Frontend: GM negative case verified — at /app/sessions/6e63d81b-... as gm@, [data-testid='actor-popover'] is absent (GM doesn't own a character) ✓. V3.7 regression: .av-stage element renders with data-gm-speaking='false' attribute present ✓. End-to-end integration spot-confirmed in the SAME GM session screenshot — the [journal]-tagged chat rows my backend tests inserted (TEST_V38 owner journal — found a glass shard at the river / Distilled a Serenitas vial...) render in the chat-panel with 'GAME MASTER · JOURNAL' kind tag and the [journal] message prefix, proving WS broadcast + chat-panel kind='journal' rendering end-to-end. ActorPopover positive-self case (popover renders for active-init owned character) NOT exercised end-to-end with Playwright — would require registering+seating a player, character creation, initiative manipulation, AV voice join. Per the request's fallback note + 'don't waste time on WebRTC', the component testid surface and roll-options builder were validated by source review: all 8 required testids present in /app/frontend/src/components/ActorPopover.jsx (actor-popover, actor-popover-close, actor-popover-derived, roll-options, roll-opt-${kind}-${i}, journal-this-turn, journal-input, journal-submit). The buildBesmRollOptions builder always emits 3 stat rows (Body/Mind/Soul as kind:'stat') + 1-N attr rows + 0-N skill rows + 2 raw rows (2d6, 1d20) — meeting the 'multiple roll-opt-stat-* / -attr-* / -skill-* / -raw-* rows' acceptance criterion.
action_items: (LOW / spec drift) The review_request mentioned [data-testid='session-roll-log'] for the dice broadcast log but no such testid exists in the codebase — SessionView.jsx renders dice rows as data-testid='dice-log-{id}' inside data-testid='dice-panel'. Either the spec is stale or a wrapper testid 'session-roll-log' should be added to the dice-panel log container so future Playwright assertions match. Behaviour itself works (rolls appear in the LOG pane).

(INFO) ActorPopover active-self render path requires (joined AV) + (owns char) + (active in init). End-to-end Playwright coverage of this path was deferred per request's fallback. If desired, add a unit-mount harness or a /__test__/popover route that mounts <ActorPopover> with stub props to allow CI assertion of click-to-roll + journal-submit without AV.

(INFO) Cleanup: the TEST_V38 journal entries written into Cyma's folio.journal during testing are persisted in the seed campaign 8dcab411-... — re-running POST /api/campaigns/{cid}/seed/evereantha will reset Cyma. The legacy-coercion test ends with folio.journal == [TEST_V38 post-coercion entry] (size=1) — re-seed if subsequent tests expect Cyma's pre-seeded journal.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/characters/{cid}/journal correctly checks owner OR GM, defensively coerces non-array journal to [], strips text, includes by_uid+by_name+created_at on the entry, and only echoes a chat row when session_id belongs to the same campaign — matches spec exactly.
Pydantic JournalEntryIn uses Field(min_length=1, max_length=2000) — hits 422 cleanly at the boundary; verified.

ActorPopover.jsx uses createPortal + getBoundingClientRect with resize+scroll listeners and clamps to viewport (margin=12, W=360, flips above tile if bottom overflow) — solid anchoring approach. Outside-click handler correctly excludes anchorEl + popRef.

AVSeats.jsx renders ActorPopover only when (isActiveSelf && popoverOpen && myCharacter && sessionId) — matches the four-condition gate spec; popoverOpen resets on activeUid change so initiative rotation reopens.

JournalThisTurn submit calls api.post and clears textarea + flashes 'Saved ✓' for 1.8s — the savedAt timeout is 1800ms which means the 'Saved ✓' indicator is brief; a Playwright check should sample the button text within that window (or wait_for_function on text=='Saved ✓').

buildBesmRollOptions correctly filters via campaign.prohibited_attributes / prohibited_skill_groups Sets, dominant() picks Body/Mind/Soul by name regex with a max() fallback — pure function, easily unit-testable in isolation per the request's 'other_misc_info' note.

/api/characters/{cid}/journal does not 404 when the character has no campaign (camp may be None), but get_current_user is required so anonymous can't hit it. Edge case: orphan character (no campaign) → camp=None → is_gm=False → only owner can journal — that's a reasonable degradation, but consider adding an explicit 404 if campaign missing.
server.py is now 1771 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline. Should be split (auth, characters, sessions, recap, knowledge web) into modules; carryover comment from prior iterations still applies.
